title: A destroyed prompt hangs the app forever - no error, no toast, no log
description: Surfaced by MPI-450's H3 smoke investigation, DEFERRED TO 1.5 by Fabio on 2026-08-10 so 1.4 can ship. When a prompt disappears from ComfyUI mid-flight, comfyController's history poll cannot tell 'not written to history yet' from 'gone', so it spins until something else gives up: the progress bar sits frozen, no error is emitted, no toast fires, nothing lands in the log, and on a Pod the user is billed while watching a dead generation. The runner in scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs already has the correct three-signal detection to port - absent from history AND absent from the queue AND the engine answering - so this is a port, not a design problem. NOTE the MPI-450 caveat: that same detector was found on 2026-08-10 to have a false-positive path, so port the detector WITH its guard, or this ships a spurious error where today it ships a hang.
